name: Survivorship bias measurement
hypothesis: Current-listings-only data flattered past long-only results
result: Survivors-only universe overstates long-only CAGR by +1.2pp (EW), +1.3pp (12-1 mom), +2.4pp (5d losers), +5.3pp (high vol), 2016-24; delisting-return assumption moves <0.15pp; pre-2017-10 delistings still partly missing (true bias larger)
next_action: use the survivorship-free store for every future long-only test

name: Realised-vol forecast beats implied vol
hypothesis: QuantLab's forecast of realised movement is more accurate than ATM IV, and the error predicts straddle returns
result: QuantLab's RV forecast beats raw IV overall (OOS MSE 0.123 vs 0.197) and adds information beyond IV even in liquid options (encompassing t 12.7), but IV alone wins among liquid options in 2023-24 (0.091 debiased vs 0.123); every realistic straddle book (ask in, bid out / intrinsic) loses after spreads
next_action: the ONE answer to Part 49: QuantLab has incremental volatility information but not enough to pay option spreads; revisit only with cheaper execution (mid fills) or a longer-dated / less spread-intensive structure

name: IV vs RV / variance risk premium (Goyal-Saretto)
hypothesis: Straddles on stocks with HV>>IV beat straddles with HV<<IV
result: HV-IV decile ranking monotonic in the full universe, but largely an illiquidity artefact; in liquid options (spread<=10%) long-top/short-bottom loses -4%/trade OOS (t -2.2)
next_action: retire as tradeable; keep as a description of option richness

name: Short-term reversal matrix
hypothesis: Recent relative losers outperform recent winners over the next days, net of costs, market-neutral
result: 160 variants: no variant positive net in TRAIN; best TRAIN Sharpe -0.10; OOS 2022-24 -31% (Sharpe -0.55); costs (turnover 0.2-1.5/day) exceed the 0-4 bps/day gross
next_action: retire; only a low-turnover large-cap version could change this and the literature says it decayed after 2011

name: Pre-earnings straddle (exit before announcement)
hypothesis: ATM straddles bought 1-5 days before earnings and sold before the announcement earn positive returns
result: pre-earnings straddle: mid-to-mid +1.7-2.4% but the non-earnings placebo earns the same; paying spreads (11-15% each side) -30% per trade, hit rate 4-6%
next_action: retire; published effect not reproduced as event-specific

name: Expected move vs realised move
hypothesis: Implied expected moves systematically mis-state realised moves in identifiable buckets
result: realised/expected move averages 0.82-1.05 (median 0.64-0.85); earnings windows ~fair (0.93-1.00); high-IV non-earnings most overpriced (0.82) but short vol at the bid loses after spreads
next_action: the only premium is in high-IV non-earnings names; needs sub-spread execution

name: Option momentum
hypothesis: Past straddle returns predict future straddle returns beyond underlying momentum
result: option momentum: monotonic deciles in the full universe, flat among liquid options; L/S liquid OOS -4.1% (t -3.0)
next_action: retire as tradeable

name: IV term structure

name: ML target separation
hypothesis: Simple models predict magnitude/vol OOS but not direction
result: OOS 2022-24: DIRECTION AUC 0.514-0.518, TIMING 0.50-0.52 (not predictable); MAGNITUDE rank IC 0.36 (vs 0.32 trailing vol), VOLATILITY IC 0.80 (vs 0.69), TAIL AUC 0.70 (vs 0.68). Trees overfit TRAIN (AUC 0.70-0.82) without beating linear OOS.
next_action: use magnitude/vol forecasts for risk sizing and as option-pricing context, not as a direction signal
